messages.author: c8df6bcabcda632f
messages.subject: scale with geom_hline
parts:
I would like to have a geom_hline at each of the ticks on the y axis.
How might I access the data used to generate the scale?

p <- ggplot(dframe, aes(date, currency))
p + geom_line(colour = 'navyblue')
p + geom_hline(???)

Thanks in advance.

g.

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: scale with geom_hline
parts:
Hi G,

ggplot2 currently uses grid.pretty to generate the tick marks given
the axis ranges.

Hadley
